name: std::iswctype
intro:
Classifies the wide character wc using the current C locale's LC_CTYPE category identified by desc.

If the value of wc is neither representable as a wchar_t nor equal to the value of the macro WEOF, the behavior is undefined.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
wc

 -

 the wide character to classify


 desc

 -

 the LC_CTYPE category, obtained from a call to std::wctype

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: Non-zero if the character wc has the property identified by desc in LC_CTYPE facet of the current C locale, zero otherwise.

examples.output:
The character \u6c34 is...
digit? false
alpha? true
space? false
cntrl? false
jkanji? true
